headline: A-list celebrity uses your product on camera
body: Nobody asked permission. Fifty million people just watched them use your app live, and your servers are starting to buckle.

options.label: Scale the servers immediately
options.detail: Spend whatever it takes, right now, to keep the app up while the moment lasts.
options.storyHeadline: Scaled up fast for a celebrity moment

options.label: Ride the wave
options.detail: Don't spend anything. Hope the infrastructure holds on its own.
options.storyHeadline: Survived viral moment

headline: Your product is now a meme
body: Somebody found something funny about your app, and it will not stop spreading. A hundred thousand posts in a day. Some of them are even kind.

options.label: Embrace it
options.detail: Post funny responses yourself and lean all the way into the joke.
options.storyHeadline: Leaned into becoming an internet meme

options.label: Ignore it and stay focused
options.detail: Say nothing publicly. There's real work to do either way.
options.storyHeadline: Stayed above the fray

headline: A giant copies your entire product
body: A company a thousand times your size just launched something suspiciously identical to what you've spent years building.

options.label: Lawyer up and sue
options.detail: Fight it on principle, whatever the legal bill turns out to be.
options.storyHeadline: Took on a giant over a stolen idea

options.label: Sell them the part they didn't copy
options.detail: Take a payout for whatever they still need from you instead of fighting them.
options.storyHeadline: Took a payout instead of fighting the copy

headline: Your name is rude in another language
body: {COMPANY} means something very unfortunate in a market of 80 million people.

options.label: Rebrand there only
options.detail: Mildly confusing, forever, in one country.
options.storyHeadline: Rebranded in one unfortunate market

options.label: Rebrand everywhere
options.detail: A clean slate, at a real cost.
options.storyHeadline: Rebranded the whole company

options.label: Do nothing, it's free advertising
options.detail: Sales in that country are enormous, for the wrong reason.
options.storyHeadline: Leaned into an accidentally rude name

headline: A famous person tags you by mistake
body: They meant to tag a company with a similar name. Four million people didn't check.

options.label: Say nothing and take the customers
options.detail: A huge spike. Almost none of it sticks.
options.storyHeadline: Quietly kept the customers from a viral mistake

options.label: Politely correct it
options.detail: They thank you publicly. Worth more than the traffic.
options.storyHeadline: Corrected a viral mix-up honestly

headline: The office floods
body: A pipe upstairs. Nobody was there. The photographs are extraordinary.

options.label: Claim on insurance
options.detail: Six weeks of paperwork. Most of it comes back.
options.storyHeadline: Claimed on insurance after a flood

options.label: Post the photos
options.detail: It goes mildly viral. A few journalists call.
options.storyHeadline: Posted the flood photos online

headline: Someone bought your domain name
body: They want a number with five digits in it. They're 19 and completely within their rights.

options.label: Pay
options.detail: Done. Mildly humiliating.
options.storyHeadline: Paid to get the company's own domain back

options.label: Refuse and rename
options.detail: Expensive, but the domain problem is gone for good.
options.storyHeadline: Rebranded rather than pay for a domain

headline: A conspiracy theory about your product
body: People believe your product does something it very much does not do.

options.label: Explain calmly
options.detail: Nobody listens. It fades in four months.
options.storyHeadline: Calmly explained away a conspiracy theory

options.label: Make a joke of it
options.detail: Signups jump. Some people are furious.
options.storyHeadline: Made a joke out of a conspiracy theory

headline: Your logo means something rude when small
body: At 16 pixels it is not what you intended. Someone made a very popular post about this.

options.label: Fix it quietly
options.detail: A quiet, cheap correction.
options.storyHeadline: Quietly fixed an unfortunate logo

options.label: Sell merchandise of the bad version
options.detail: A permanent, profitable reputation.
options.storyHeadline: Sold merchandise of the accidentally rude logo

headline: Birdwatchers have taken over your product
body: Your software is being used by 4,000 birdwatchers to log sightings. Nobody knows why.

options.label: Build them a real version
options.detail: A whole new, unplanned business.
options.storyHeadline: Built a real product for the birdwatchers

options.label: Do nothing
options.detail: They stay forever, your most loyal, strangest customers.
options.storyHeadline: Let the birdwatchers keep doing their thing

headline: A hit song mentions your company
body: It isn't flattering. It is extremely catchy.

options.label: Embrace it, sponsor the tour
options.detail: Expensive. The brand becomes genuinely famous.
options.storyHeadline: Sponsored the tour of a song that mocked you

options.label: Do nothing
options.detail: Awareness soars. Sales climb. You're a little embarrassed for a decade.
options.storyHeadline: Did nothing about a hit song mocking the company

headline: Your biggest customer is a criminal enterprise
body: A journalist calls to ask how well you know them.

options.label: Cut them off immediately
options.detail: Revenue drops. Reputation stays clean.
options.storyHeadline: Cut off a customer under investigation

options.label: Wait for proof
options.detail: A real gamble on what the story finds.
options.storyHeadline: Waited for proof before acting on a bad customer

gamble.loseText: The story ran, with your name in it.
gamble.winStoryHeadline: The story about a bad customer came to nothing
gamble.loseStoryHeadline: Named in a story about a bad customer

headline: A drunk billionaire offers to buy you at 3am
body: The message is real. The number is absurd. It's 3am.

options.label: Reply immediately
options.detail: A real gamble on whether they remember sending it.
options.storyHeadline: Replied to a 3am acquisition offer immediately

gamble.winText: They meant every word. It's the deal of your life.
gamble.loseText: They don't remember. Their assistant does, and isn't impressed.

options.label: Screenshot it and tell nobody
options.detail: Nothing happens. You have a very good story.
options.storyHeadline: Screenshotted a 3am billionaire and moved on

headline: A cat shipped a bug
body: An engineer's cat stood on a keyboard during a video call. The bug reached 40,000 customers.

options.label: Tell the truth publicly
options.detail: The internet loves you for it, for a week.
options.storyHeadline: Told the truth about a cat-caused bug

options.label: Blame the process, fix the process
options.detail: Nobody's fault, on the record. Respect goes up.
options.storyHeadline: Fixed the process after a cat-caused bug

headline: Someone left you money
body: {MENTOR} died and left their shares to you.

options.label: Give them to the staff
options.detail: A gesture that buys permanent loyalty.
options.storyHeadline: Gave an inherited stake to the staff

options.label: Accept
options.detail: You feel strange about it for years.
options.storyHeadline: Accepted an inherited stake

headline: Your rival hires your mother
body: She says the commute is better and they have a canteen.

options.label: Laugh about it publicly
options.detail: Everyone loves it. {RIVAL} looks ridiculous.
options.storyHeadline: Made a joke of a rival hiring your mother

options.label: Take it extremely personally
options.detail: You look a little unwell about it.
options.storyHeadline: Took a family hire by a rival very personally

headline: A parcel arrives that nobody ordered
body: Four hundred branded umbrellas. Somebody approved this eleven months ago.

options.label: Hand them out and move on
options.detail: Morale ticks up. Storage is a problem for later.
options.storyHeadline: Handed out four hundred mystery umbrellas

headline: The power goes out for a day
body: Everyone goes to a café and has the most productive day of the quarter.

options.label: Notice, and say nothing about it
options.detail: Nobody learns the right lesson.
options.storyHeadline: A power cut turned into the best day of the quarter

headline: A national holiday you forgot about
body: Half your market is closed for a week you didn't plan for.

options.label: Adjust and move on
options.detail: Revenue is delayed a month. No lasting harm.
options.storyHeadline: Forgot a national holiday in a key market

headline: The mascot
body: Your designer built a costume with company money, without asking. It is genuinely unsettling.

options.label: Send it to the trade show
options.detail: A real gamble on how the internet reacts.
options.storyHeadline: Sent a strange homemade mascot to a trade show

gamble.winText: It became a phenomenon. People queue to be photographed with it.
gamble.loseText: A child cried on camera. It is the only thing anyone remembers about your company.
gamble.loseStoryHeadline: The mascot became a cautionary tale

options.label: Quietly destroy it
options.detail: Cheap. The designer resigns within the year.
options.storyHeadline: Quietly destroyed the mascot costume

headline: Answer the strange email
body: An anonymous message offers something extraordinary and asks for a meeting in a city you've never visited.

options.label: Go
options.detail: Almost certainly nothing. Possibly everything.
options.storyHeadline: Followed up on a strange anonymous email

gamble.winText: It was a fund that doesn't like phone calls.
gamble.loseText: It was a man with a slide deck about a floating city. Excellent anecdote.
gamble.winStoryHeadline: A strange email turned into real money
gamble.loseStoryHeadline: A strange email turned into a great story and nothing else

options.label: Delete it
options.detail: Nothing.
options.storyHeadline: Deleted a strange anonymous email

headline: Let the intern run the account
body: Your 22-year-old intern has asked to run the company's social media for one month, unsupervised.

options.label: Give them the password
options.detail: A real gamble on their sense of humour.
options.storyHeadline: Let the intern run social media unsupervised

gamble.winText: It became genuinely funny and signups tripled.
gamble.loseText: One post ended up in a newspaper. You spent a week apologising.
gamble.winStoryHeadline: The intern's social media takeover paid off
gamble.loseStoryHeadline: The intern's social media takeover ended up in the news

options.label: Approve every post first
options.detail: It is dreadful, as always.
options.storyHeadline: Kept approving every post the intern wrote

headline: The bet with your rival
body: {RIVAL} proposes a public bet on which company hits a number first. Loser does something humiliating, publicly.

options.label: Accept
options.detail: Four million people will watch either way.
options.storyHeadline: Accepted a public bet with a rival

gamble.winText: You won. The video is seen four million times.
gamble.loseText: You lost. It follows you to every interview for a decade.
gamble.winStoryHeadline: Won a public bet against a rival
gamble.loseStoryHeadline: Lost a public bet against a rival

options.label: Decline
options.detail: {RIVAL} mentions it publicly for years.
options.storyHeadline: Declined a public bet with a rival

headline: Buy the strange building
body: A decommissioned lighthouse or a disused railway station is for sale, cheap, and would make an unforgettable office.

options.label: Buy it
options.detail: A real gamble on whether it's a landmark or a money pit.
options.storyHeadline: Bought a decommissioned building for an office

gamble.winText: It becomes the reason people want to work for you.
gamble.loseText: The roof, the damp, and the council take three years.
gamble.winStoryHeadline: The strange building became a landmark
gamble.loseStoryHeadline: The strange building became a money pit

options.label: Rent a normal office
options.detail: Normal.
options.storyHeadline: Rented a completely normal office instead

headline: An old colleague reappears
body: Someone from before the company wants to catch up. They have money now.

options.label: Meet them
options.detail: A real gamble on what they actually want.
options.storyHeadline: Met an old colleague who reappeared with money

gamble.winText: They invested, no drama at all.
gamble.loseText: They wanted a job. An awkward coffee.
gamble.winStoryHeadline: An old colleague came back and invested
gamble.loseStoryHeadline: An old colleague came back wanting a job

options.label: Don't
options.detail: Nothing.
options.storyHeadline: Skipped catching up with an old colleague

headline: Your product appears in a film
body: Nobody asked you. Nobody paid you.

options.label: Enjoy it
options.detail: A month of extra signups, unprompted.
options.storyHeadline: Watched signups spike after an unplanned film cameo

headline: The whole team took the same day off by accident
body: A scheduling mix-up, not a holiday — everyone independently decided to skip the same Friday. Nothing broke.

options.label: Make it official next year
options.detail: Turn the accident into a standing day off. Morale ticks up for something that cost nothing.
options.storyHeadline: Made an accidental day off official
